customManagers.description: Update `rev = "..."` pins in prek.toml annotated with a `# renovate:` comment (Renovate's built-in pre-commit manager only handles .pre-commit-config.yaml, not prek.toml).

Bump the proto toolchain pins in config/proto/.prototools (Renovate has no native proto manager). Each `<tool> = "<version>"` line is annotated with a `# renovate:` comment carrying its datasource/depName.
